fullDescription:
Elevate your typography with refined artistic poise, editorial grace, and high-fashion luxury with ESPÉNA! This modern display serif pairs high-contrast vertical stems with delicate sharp serifs, sweeping diagonal strokes, and distinct geometric accents. Its noble silhouette brings an unforced rhythm and quiet authority to contemporary brand design.

Ideal for luxury brand identities, high-end cosmetics packaging, editorial magazine titles, boutique logo design, fine art gallery signage, and aesthetic social media layouts!
